articles.title: Parasite Protein Reverses Metabolic Inflammation — Mainstream Diet Research Has Been Looking in the Wrong Direction
articles.summary: A new PLoS Pathogens study demonstrates that a serine protease inhibitor derived from the parasitic worm Trichinella spiralis dramatically attenuates diet-induced obesity and adipose tissue inflammation by reprogramming macrophages from pro-inflammatory M1 to anti-inflammatory M2 states via a TIM-3-dependent pathway. The research validates the metabolic-inflammation theory of obesity — that fat tissue dysfunction is driven by immune dysregulation, not simply caloric surplus — a framework long sidelined by pharmaceutical and dietary guidelines focused on drugs and low-fat dogma. Follow this thread and it leads directly to questions the seed-oil and sugar industries do not want asked.
